definition: Union of catalogued R2 recording_clips intervals, split at stream-local midnight, divided by 86400 seconds. Excludes purged clips and R2 retirements; requires an R2 endpoint, bucket and object key. The span includes historical catalogued clips; missing R2 days show zero. Catalog presence, not a fresh R2 HEAD check; stitched outputs are not used to infer missing raw coverage. DST days still divide by 86400.
